p1.text:
A NOTICE WAS PINNED BESIDE THE DOUBLE DOORS,
TYPED ON THE BUILDING'S OWN FORM. I READ IT BECAUSE
THERE WAS NOTHING ELSE TO DO, AND BECAUSE THE
FORM HAD BEEN STAMPED THREE TIMES, WHICH IN THIS
BUILDING MEANS SOMEBODY EXPECTS IT TO BE READ.

IT SAID THAT FROM TODAY ALL VISITORS ARE TO BE
TREATED AS STAFF, AND ALL STAFF AS VISITORS, UNTIL
THE MATTER OF WHO IS WHICH HAS BEEN SETTLED BY
THE OFFICE CONCERNED. THE OFFICE CONCERNED IS NOT
NAMED. A SPACE HAS BEEN LEFT FOR ITS NAME, AND THE
SPACE HAS BEEN INITIALLED.

checks.name: CONTINUE replaces the passage with the next page (no history) and only the final page reveals the decisions

p2.text:
BELOW THAT, IN SMALLER TYPE, IT EXPLAINED THAT ANY
PERSON WHO BELIEVES THEY HAVE BEEN MISCLASSIFIED
MAY APPLY FOR RECLASSIFICATION AT THE DESK,
BETWEEN THE HOURS OF NINE AND NINE FIFTEEN, ON ANY
DAY THE DESK IS STAFFED. THE DESK IS STAFFED BY
VISITORS, AS OF TODAY.

AT THE VERY BOTTOM SOMEONE HAD ADDED, BY HAND,
THAT THE BATHROOM ON THIS FLOOR WAS FOR THE USE
OF STAFF ONLY, AND THAT THIS RULE HAD NOT CHANGED.
THE HANDWRITING WAS NEAT AND VERY SMALL, AS IF IT
WERE EMBARRASSED TO BE THERE AT ALL.
